erd_alignment.note: Operation bắt buộc bởi ERD nhưng chưa có mặt trong Annex C. Tất cả đều stock-neutral và phải liệt kê tường minh ở đây để API surface luôn kiểm chứng được. BA cần bổ sung vào Annex C ở revision kế tiếp.

rationale.POST /api/v1/inbound-documents/{id}/unsc: ERD bảng 28 inbound_scan_entries.status CHECK ACTIVE/REMOVED — 'Cho sửa trước Post' — cùng removed_at/removed_by và index idx_inbound_scan_line_status. Đối xứng với POST /outbound-documents/{id}/unmatch. Không có endpoint này thì quét sai một item chỉ còn cách Cancel cả phiếu, trái ý định ERD.
rationale.GET /api/v1/skus/import-reports/{id}/err: WWHN-330 (review 47/100, P1-01): review yêu cầu error file thật cho các dòng bị reject khi import, permission-aware (RBAC qua middleware permission:sku.manage — cùng pattern các endpoint import khác) và có expiry rõ ràng. Không có endpoint này thì client chỉ có JSON row_errors tức thời trong response, không có cách nào tải lại file lỗi sau đó để đối soát/gửi cho người khác.
rationale.POST /api/v1/skus/{id}/items: ERD bảng 20/21 (item_instances + physical_codes): trước bổ sung này hệ thống không có UI lẫn API nào tạo được Item_Instance kèm Physical_Code MỚI — CurrentBaselineItemIdentityController@assign và ItemInstanceController@store đều đòi hỏi physical_code_id/item đã tồn tại sẵn. Không có endpoint này thì không có cách hợp lệ nào phát hành mã Barcode/QR mới gắn cho một item chưa từng được quét/nhập, trái ý định ERD (mọi Item_Instance phải có định danh vật lý). Stock-neutral: item tạo với item_status=NEW, không cộng tồn kho.

annex_c_alignment.note: Path/permission chuẩn theo SRS v1.12 §8.1 + Annex C. Nhóm alias dùng chung handler với route hiện hành (route cũ giữ nguyên cho client đang chạy); phần còn lại là endpoint Annex C trước đây chưa hiện thực. Mọi bổ sung phải liệt kê ở đây để API surface luôn kiểm chứng được.

post_baseline_amendments.note: Operation có route runtime nhưng chưa từng được contract này đếm (contract đóng băng ở 81782ec, 23/08/2026). Liệt kê từng operation theo nhóm, mỗi nhóm có commit đưa vào, lý do và chủ sở hữu — không tăng số đếm trần. Commit là commit ĐẦU TIÊN mà route có mặt ở runtime, đo bằng `php artisan route:list` chụp ở 58 commit (thứ tự topo) từ 81782ec tới e5dbe0d; với commit merge, feature_commits là commit khai route ở nhánh con. Ghi bù ngày 10/09/2026; chưa có sign-off nào.

groups.title: P01 work shift identity
groups.rationale: Start/current persist the actor and stable auth-session warehouse identity; source presence does not authorize END or production activation.

groups.title: P03 scoped personal drafts and receipts
groups.rationale: Persist personal staging snapshots with per-operation permissions and exact actor/session/warehouse identity; reconcile does not replay an unknown write.

groups.title: P04 typed inbound owner adapter
groups.rationale: Typed staging reuses P03 receipts and canonical record ownership. It does not expose a new stock posting path; supplier lookup remains a permission-guarded global directory.

groups.title: P05 outbound source reads
groups.rationale: Read selected existing source documents under outbound rights and confirmed warehouse scope. No second outbound writer or new posting endpoint.

groups.title: P06 read-only catalog identities
groups.rationale: Distinct SKU and item reads, warehouse-scoped stock, gallery and timeline. Permission/context capabilities do not imply stock-write eligibility.

groups.title: P07 NFC owner confirmation and reservation release
groups.rationale: Scoped tag reads and owner receipt reconciliation remain separate from audit history. Release is an existing explicit owner command, not permission to create physical test evidence.

groups.title: P08 read-only persisted history
groups.rationale: Scoped record, summary, detail and session reads preserve source permission checks and partial-source semantics; no fixture fallback or history writer.

groups.title: P09 warranty command reconciliation
groups.rationale: Read the exact warranty owner command result under actor/session/warehouse identity; absence is UNKNOWN and never authorizes a replacement command.

groups.title: P14 gated recovery and shift closure
groups.rationale: Source routes remain gated. Closure requires owner tracking, server close-check, exact version/key/token and genuine local CLEAN. Recovery and END are separate activations.
groups.approval: PENDING (BA + QA live acceptance; not activation)

groups.title: P18 owner upload receipt reads
groups.rationale: Read-only reconciliation for the existing upload owners; parent ACL plus actor/session/warehouse/key/file digest remain mandatory. UNKNOWN is CHECK_ONLY.

groups.title: P19 gated canonical command reconciliation
groups.rationale: Check the original component command under the existing owner contract; no new stock writer or automatic recovery activation.
groups.approval: PENDING (BA + QA live acceptance; not activation)

groups.title: P20 component history by warranty case
groups.rationale: Read existing linked component documents with warranty/component/documents permissions and persisted warehouse ownership; never manufactures history.

groups.title: P23 persisted scan-session aggregate
groups.rationale: Read-only persisted batch metadata and full-source latest event under history/inventory scope. Partial totals stay null and unsupported fields are not inferred.

groups.title: P12 mixed document read list
groups.rationale: One permission- and warehouse-scoped SQL aggregate with server sort/keyset pagination and fail-closed sources. Contract v3 and timestamp metadata are revisions of this existing GET, not additional endpoints.

groups.title: P11 gated security command receipt and step-up verification
groups.rationale: Existing exact-key actor/family security owner routes. Protocol activation is independent of route presence; revoked sessions are not revived and UNKNOWN remains check-only.

groups.title: Persisted human document CHECK and exact request reconciliation
groups.rationale: Existing inbound/outbound explicit human confirmation, distinct from RECORD validation or SENT handoff. Both view and scan permissions, warehouse/owner/version guards and original command identity remain required.

groups.title: SKU import quality issue rows and Excel read export
groups.rationale: Existing sku.manage-scoped read operations for persisted import report issues. No import write, catalog change or stock effect is admitted by these GETs.

groups.title: Outbound NFC item and history reads
groups.rationale: Existing outbound.view reads with persisted item/document links and outbound warehouse scope. Not NFC prepare, confirm, release or a replacement write receipt.

groups.title: P10 self-service avatar, preferences and device ownership
groups.rationale: Existing personal endpoints guarded by fresh active actor/stable family and exact current or foreign device checks. Direct P10 handler declarations do not broaden permission or role scope.

groups.title: Self-scoped ended login device history
groups.rationale: Existing current actor login-family history read; it does not make ended or replaced sessions valid or expose foreign device records.

groups.title: DEV notification delivery capabilities and scoped installation registry
groups.rationale: Existing owner/family/installation proof and strong-version registry lifecycle. Source presence is not delivery activation, device consent, provider acceptance or production approval.
groups.owner: Notification owner + Security + DEV Ops + QA
groups.approval: PENDING (Security + QA; separate DEV activation and device consent)

groups.title: Gated exact-key notification self-test and receipt read
groups.rationale: Existing explicit self-test admission and original-key receipt read. UNKNOWN cannot be replayed; listing these routes never enables self-test, canary, normal delivery or historical resend.
groups.owner: Notification owner + Security + DEV Ops + QA
groups.approval: PENDING (Security + QA; self-test activation remains separate)

groups.title: IAM private user avatar read
groups.rationale: Existing iam.user.view-guarded private image read, separate from the caller self-service avatar. No public image ACL or caller role-name bypass.
